name: Bada Bagh
description: Royal cenotaphs of Jaisalmer's rulers set against the desert. Stunning sunset and sunrise photography spot.

name: Gadisar Lake
description: Ancient rainwater harvesting lake surrounded by temples, shrines, and ghats. Pedal boating available.

name: Jain Temples (Inside Fort)
description: Cluster of 7 interconnected Jain temples from 12th-15th century inside Jaisalmer Fort. Exquisite sandstone carvings.

name: Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila)
description: UNESCO World Heritage living fort built in 1156. One of the few forts with a still-inhabited population inside.

name: Kuldhara Abandoned Village
description: Ghost village abandoned overnight by Paliwal Brahmins in 1825. Ruins with an eerie legend of a curse.

name: Nathmal Ki Haveli
description: Prime Minister's haveli with mirror-image facades carved by two brothers. Each side slightly different.

name: Patwon Ki Haveli
description: Cluster of five interconnected havelis with the finest sandstone carvings in Rajasthan. Built by Jain merchants.

name: Sam Sand Dunes
description: Thar Desert dunes 42 km from Jaisalmer. Camel safaris, cultural programs, and spectacular sunsets.

name: Tanot Mata Temple
description: Border temple that survived Pakistani bombing in 1971 war. Army-maintained miracle site near BSF border post.

name: Bihar Museum
description: Modern museum with galleries spanning from Mauryan era to modern Bihar. Interactive displays and children's gallery.

name: Golghar
description: Giant beehive-shaped granary built in 1786 by the British. Climb 145 steps for panoramic Patna views.

name: Kumhrar (Pataliputra Ruins)
description: Excavated ruins of the ancient Mauryan capital Pataliputra. 80-pillar assembly hall from 3rd century BC.

name: Mahavir Mandir
description: One of the most visited temples in Bihar. Dedicated to Hanuman. Known for prasad and charitable works.

name: Patna Museum
description: Houses the world's longest fossil tree (200 million years), Didarganj Yakshi sculpture, and Buddha relics.

name: Takht Sri Patna Sahib
description: One of five Sikh Takhts — birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh. Sacred pilgrimage site with ornate architecture.

name: Bright End Corner
description: Sunrise and sunset viewpoint with panoramic views of the Himalayan range including Nanda Devi.

name: Jageshwar Temple Complex
description: Cluster of 124 large and small stone temples from 7th-14th century. Important Shiva worship center in dense deodar forest.

name: Kasar Devi Temple
description: Ancient temple on a ridge with geomagnetic properties (NASA-detected Van Allen Belt anomaly). Cosmic energy site.

name: Lala Bazaar
description: Famous for Almora's bal mithai (chocolate-coated fudge) and singori (sweet wrapped in malu leaf).

name: Diskit Monastery
description: 14th-century monastery with a massive 32-meter Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley.

name: Hunder Sand Dunes
description: Cold desert sand dunes at 10,000 ft. Double-humped Bactrian camel safari across the surreal landscape.

name: Panamik Hot Springs
description: Natural sulphur hot springs in the remote northern part of Nubra Valley near the Siachen area.

name: Samstanling Monastery Sumur
description: Peaceful monastery surrounded by poplar trees with views of Nubra Valley.

name: Bet Dwarka Island
description: Island where Krishna lived. 30-min boat ride. Ancient Krishna temple with underwater archaeological discoveries nearby.

name: Dwarkadhish Temple
description: Five-storey Krishna temple — one of the Char Dhams. 2,500 years old with 72 pillars. Evening aarti is powerful.

name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
description: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas with a massive 80-ft Shiva statue outside. 17 km from Dwarka.

name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
description: World's only floating national park. Last refuge of the endangered Sangai (Manipur brow-antlered deer).

name: Loktak Lake Boat Ride
description: Largest freshwater lake in NE India. Floating phumdis (biomass islands) including the floating Keibul Lamjao NP.

name: Sendra Island
description: Hillock island in Loktak Lake with a tourist lodge. Panoramic views of the lake and phumdis.

name: Somnath Sound & Light Show
description: Dramatic narration of the temple's 2,000-year history of destruction and resurrection. By Amitabh Bachchan.

name: Somnath Temple
description: First of the 12 Jyotirlingas. Rebuilt 17 times across 2,000 years. Current structure in Chalukya style overlooking Arabian Sea.

name: Triveni Sangam (Bhalka Tirth)
description: Where Krishna was struck by an arrow. Sacred confluence of Hiran, Kapila, and Saraswati rivers near the temple.

name: Keoladeo National Park
description: UNESCO World Heritage bird sanctuary. Over 350 species including rare Siberian crane. Cycle or rickshaw safari.

name: Lohagarh Fort
description: Iron Fort that withstood British attacks. Three palaces inside and a museum of sculpture and paintings.

name: Betlingchhip Peak (Highest)
description: Highest point of Jampui Hills at 914m. 360° views of North Tripura plateau and valleys. Year-round clear views.

name: Forest Trails & Bird-Watching
description: Dense forest with wild orchids and rhododendrons. Bird-watching hotspot, over 100 species recorded.

name: Lolab Valley Meadow
description: Flat-bottomed valley with walnut groves and wildflowers. Called "Heaven of Kashmir" with very few tourists.

name: Satbaran
description: Scenic spot with seven doors (sat baran) of mountains creating natural frames. Photography paradise.

name: Man & Merak Villages
description: Changpa nomad settlements along Pangong Lake. Traditional yak-hair tents and unique culture.

name: Pangong Tso Viewpoint
description: Stunning 134 km long endorheic lake at 14,270 ft. Changes colors from azure to turquoise to green.

name: Sissu Lake
description: Glacial-fed turquoise lake surrounded by towering peaks. Starting point for Gepang Gath trek.

name: Sissu Waterfall
description: Multi-tiered waterfall cascading down the mountainside near the village. Visible from highway.

name: Bhimbetka Rock Shelters
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with 30,000-year-old cave paintings. Oldest known rock art in India.

name: Juna Mahal
description: Seven-storied 13th-century palace-fortress with original frescoes, mirror work, and miniature paintings intact.

name: Nalsarovar Boat Safari
description: Boat ride through reed beds and lotus-covered waters. Flamingos, pelicans, cranes visible at close range.

name: Saheth-Maheth Ruins
description: Ancient ruins of Jetavana monastery where Buddha spent 24 monsoon seasons. Archaeological excavations ongoing.
